wish: someone should make an oven timer that counts negative after it hits zero
spec:
Counts down from a set time and, at zero, beeps and keeps counting in red negative time (-0:42) so you see how overdue the food is.
Pick a preset or type minutes or m:ss, tap start; pause, resume or reset any time; state survives a reload.
It does not run in the background when the tab is closed, and it will not alarm if the phone is locked and silenced.
notes: Beep and timing run while the page is open; offline, no background alarm.
